verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Synctera serves an llms.txt at docs.synctera.com/llms.txt that indexes per-version LLM-oriented markdown bundles (e.g. v2 with 668 pages). Additional `_llms/` markdown files (learning-center, v2) and .md doc pages corroborate agent-oriented docs, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and any first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Enhanced due diligence (EDD) lets you submit additional information about high-risk customers, businesses, accounts, and transactions to support anti-money-laundering review and Customer Risk Rating.
